description: Intact office mail dispatch alcove: orderly low mail pigeonholes, two small trays, clean slate acoustic wall panels and ventilation.
Intact long document processing office: understated low filing cabinets, sparse paper trays and conduit, clean repetitive wall panel bays.
Intact long executive administration corridor: tidy low credenzas and shelving, orderly acoustic wall panel bays, slightly more austere and imposing.
Windowless dark records puzzle chamber: closed shallow filing drawers, solid acoustic panels and an unlit ventilation grille, deep muted navy. No light sources.

Darkshang's ominous corporate office threshold, broad quiet wall panels, a few hairline cracks, a slightly crooked blank frame, distant low executive furniture. Beginning of structural unease, still mostly intact. Cool night colours; no red tint yet because an animated eclipse will change the lighting in engine.

Windowless dark archive on the escape: early structural damage, hairline wall cracks, one loosened ceiling panel, slightly skewed file drawers. Deep midnight plum navy, very low contrast; no light sources.

Office processing hall during collapse, stage 2 of 9: widening plaster cracks, first missing acoustic panels revealing dark studs, a dangling short cable, tilted filing cabinet at bottom. Muted indigo slate with restrained bruised plum undertone.

Damaged document office during escape, stage 3 of 9: split wall panels, bent ceiling grid, hanging conduit, toppled low drawer unit and a thin scattering of papers at bottom. More damaged than first cracks, recognizable corporate office. Indigo plum slate.

Damaged mail dispatch office during escape, stage 4 of 9: burst mail slots, broken wall cladding, loose panel leaning at bottom, exposed service pipes and a crooked ceiling grid. Muted blue slate with dusty rose undertone.

Windowless dark archive during chase, stage 5 of 9: torn acoustic panel faces, widening wall fractures, exposed studs and crushed drawer fronts at the base. Deep navy plum, very low contrast, no glowing elements or light sources.

Windowless electrical records office during chase, stage 6 of 9: hanging service cabinet door, heavily split cladding, torn conduit, fallen acoustic ceiling tiles and broken cabinet at the base. Deep navy charcoal, very low contrast, no light sources.

Windowless listening archive during chase, stage 7 of 9: extensive missing plaster showing dark structural laths, bent ceiling framework, loose cable loops, crushed storage drawers along base. Very dark navy charcoal, no light sources.

Office copy room in advanced collapse, stage 8 of 9: wall sections have fallen inward revealing dark studs, buckled ceiling grid, split copier casing low at edge, jagged plaster slabs at base. Remaining blue-grey office panels readable; subtle dusty mauve and amber in shadows.

Office stair landing close to total collapse, stage 9 of 9: broad missing sections of interior wall reveal dark service voids and broken studs, ceiling grid hanging askew, severed conduits, smashed low furniture at edges. Muted slate with restrained dusty warm accents; no open sky, preserve quiet central negative space.

Last ruined office passage before home: near-total collapse around edges, peeled wall cladding and exposed structural ribs, dangling ceiling fragments, low debris and office drawers crushed at base. Quiet intact central wall bay as visual breathing room, subdued slate and warm ochre dusk-to-dawn undertones.

Return to Hooshang's original employee cubicle office at dawn. Recognizable clean blue-grey wall panel grid from the opening cubicle; intact quiet central workspace with low filing cabinet silhouettes, structural cracks and fallen ceiling panel fragments only around outer edges. Gentle desaturated warm peach and old gold reflected tint from dawn, preserving cool shadow contrast. No desk or chair in foreground because the original cubicle is a real prop added in game; leave lower left clear. No window or sunrise painted: the original dawn window is a separate scene.

Intact office waiting and review corridor: understated wall-mounted notice case without writing, orderly panel bays, low cabinets and sparse paper stacks. Cold slate navy teal, clean office architecture.
Intact office appraisal records corridor: long low drawer cabinets, a few neatly aligned binders, understated wall conduits and quiet acoustic panel bays, cold slate blue.
Intact shared office service hall: recessed storage alcoves low on wall, sparse office supplies, clean panel grid with restrained muted teal accent trim.
Remote office overflow storage corridor: tidy cabinets with one or two scuffs, restrained ventilation and horizontal wall trim, cold navy slate grey panels.

Tall vertical office service well: three stacked levels of panelled back wall, clean ventilation grilles and straight vertical conduits, a low service cabinet only at bottom. No stairs, ledges or platforms. Cold slate blue grey.

Tall vertical office maintenance shaft: stacked acoustic wall bays separated by thin trim, recessed service panels, paired narrow conduits, subtle wear. No stairs, ledges or platforms. Cold desaturated slate navy.
Intact office facilities training room: quiet wall panels, low closed equipment cabinets, subtle ventilation and muted blue trim, sparse and orderly.
Intact office maintenance workshop back wall: low tool drawers, a closed service cabinet, sparse conduit and orderly navy acoustic panels. Quiet negative space for gameplay.
